1.w: “But now, O Job, listen to my words, and hear everything I have to say.

2.w: See now, I have opened my mouth; my tongue in my mouth has spoken.

3.w: My words come from the uprightness of my heart, and my lips will utter knowledge sincerely.

4.w: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

5.w: Reply to me, if you can; set your arguments in order before me and take your stand.

6.w: Look, I am just like you in relation to God; I too have been molded from clay.

7.w: Therefore no fear of me should terrify you, nor should my pressure be heavy on you.

8.w: “Indeed, you have said in my hearing (I heard the sound of the words!):

9.w: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean and have no iniquity.

10.w: Yet God finds occasions with me; he regards me as his enemy.

11.w: He puts my feet in shackles; he watches closely all my paths.’

12.w: Now in this, you are not right—I answer you, for God is greater than a human being.

13.w: Why do you contend against him, that he does not answer all a person’s words?

14.w: “For God speaks, the first time in one way, the second time in another, though a person does not perceive it.

15.w: In a dream, a night vision, when deep sleep falls on people as they sleep in their beds,

16.w: then he gives a revelation to people and terrifies them with warnings,

17.w: to turn a person from his sin, and to cover a person’s pride.

18.w: He spares a person’s life from corruption, his very life from crossing over the river.

19.w: Or a person is chastened by pain on his bed and with the continual strife of his bones,

20.w: so that his life loathes food and his soul rejects appetizing fare.

21.w: His flesh wastes away from sight, and his bones, which were not seen, are easily visible.

22.w: He draws near to the place of corruption, and his life to the messengers of death.

23.w: If there is an angel beside him, one mediator out of a thousand, to tell a person what constitutes his uprightness,

24.w: and if God is gracious to him and says, ‘Spare him from going down to the place of corruption, I have found a ransom for him,’

25.w: then his flesh is restored like a youth’s; he returns to the days of his youthful vigor.

26.w: He entreats God, and God delights in him; he sees God’s face with rejoicing, and God restores to him his righteousness.

27.w: That person sings to others, saying: ‘I have sinned and falsified what is right, but I was not punished according to what I deserved.

28.w: He redeemed my life from going down to the place of corruption, and my life sees the light!’

29.w: “Indeed, God does all these things, twice, three times, in his dealings with a person,

30.w: to turn back his life from the place of corruption, that he may be enlightened with the light of life.

31.w: Pay attention, Job—listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

32.w: If you have any words, reply to me; speak, for I want to justify you.

33.w: If not, you listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom.”
